description: Save a Drop Radar search and get a signed webhook (event radar.match, header X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the body with the returned secret) and/or email (double opt-in) when new names match or a pending-delete name drops. Free: 3 alerts per IP, 25 with an API key, max 20 events per alert per day. filters takes the same fields as drop_radar.

filters.description: same fields as drop_radar (preset, tlds, keywords, max_len, min_quality, ...)
